description: BTCUSDT 1-minute bars of Binance spot, 2026-09 (UTC), for the documentation's examples.
encoding: Six whole numbers per bar: minutes since the previous bar (0 for the first, which starts at "from"), open minus the previous close ("basePrice" before the first bar), high minus the larger of open and close, the smaller of open and close minus low, close minus open, all in price steps, then the volume in volume steps.
